short_release_notes:
Build 99 retains explicit receiver RF coverage and server-only matching, and reduces full-grid maintenance latency by dispatching independent channel commands in bounded groups of eight. Native RF evidence continues through the normal server-authority, node-agent and sender path. Canonical matching remains on the server.

Managed update only. Existing target-based KA9Q configurations require an explicit receiver-coverage plan prepared while delivery is paused; no automatic target-list conversion or missing-plan fallback. The updater preserves managed rollback state; configuration rollback requires the preserved preimage.
